newsitem.title: USA: Willbros to build natgas pipeline in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Willbros to build natgas pipeline in Mexico.

text.p: Willbros Group Inc said Monday it has entered into a letter of intent with El Paso Energy Corp and Mexico's state-owned Pemex Gas y Petroquimica Basica, to engineer and construct a natural gas pipeline for the state-owned utility company Comision Federal de Electricidad, known as CFE.

The 45-mile, 24-inch diameter pipeline will supply natural gas from an existing El Paso Natural Gas Co pipeline near El Paso, Texas, to the Samalayuca I and II power plants in the Northern State of Chihuahua, Mexico.
The value of this contract will exceed $20 million, and the project must be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997.
